text: This report provides an update on the City Approved Toronto Public Health (TPH) 2023 Capital Budget and 2024-2032 Capital Plan. The City Approved Toronto Public Health 2023 Capital Budget is $7.491 million for nine (9) projects with future year commitments of $10.216 million. In addition to the $10.216 million, there are another eleven (11) projects totalling $16.189 million in the TPH 2024-2032 Capital Plan. The change between the BOH Recommended 2023 Capital Budget and 2024-2032 Capital Plan and the City Approved 2023 Capital Budget and 2024-2032 Capital Plan is the cash flow carried forward funding from 2022.
The Board of Health: 1. Received the report (March 29, 2023) from the Medical Officer of Health for information.
